summary: Foremost Clean Energy, a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a 6-K attaching a November 2, 2026 press release announcing commencement of its inaugural ~1,000-metre diamond drill program at the Turkey Lake Uranium Project in northern Saskatchewan. The program tests roughly four priority target areas defined by integrating a January 2026 ground gravity survey with historical drilling, electromagnetic, magnetic and geological data along over 10 kilometres of underexplored conductive strike, with shallow (~50 metres) sandstone cover. No transaction, price, stake or board recommendation is involved; this is routine exploration disclosure, not a special situation. Watch assay results and follow-on drilling.
